title: Yellowed Aerated Russian Eggs Quiche
description: A jammy, aerated, cozy Russian dish featuring egg wash, en-croute, high-protein-friendly ingredients, this quiche is perfect for a satisfying meal. It combines the richness of eggs, the flakiness of crust, and the comfort of a warm, inviting dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Trim the edges and press the dough into the corners of the pan.
Prick the bottom of the crust with a fork to prevent it from bubbling.
Line the crust with parchment paper and fill with pie weights.
Bake the crust for 15 minutes, then remove the parchment paper and pie weights.
Whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, smoked salmon, dried dill, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture into the baked crust.
Brush the edges of the crust with the beaten egg wash.
Bake the quiche for 35-40 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
